question: For which book has the Sahitya Akademi Award 2019 been awarded to Shashi Tharoor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**An Era of Darkness**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **An Era of Darkness** is a book authored by Shashi Tharoor.
 
• It is a detailed critique of the British colonial rule in India.
 
• The book was awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award in 2019**.
 
• Shashi Tharoor is a renowned Indian author, politician, and former diplomat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sahitya Akademi Award**

 
 
• The Sahitya Akademi Award is a literary honor in India, awarded annually by the Sahitya Akademi (India's National Academy of Letters).
 
• The award recognizes and promotes excellence in Indian writing and acknowledges new trends in Indian literature.
 
• The award is given in 24 languages, including English and the 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Winners receive a plaque and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor**
 
 
• Shashi Tharoor is an Indian politician, diplomat, and author.
 
• He has served as a Member of Parliament and has also held the position of Minister of State for External Affairs.
 
• Tharoor has authored several books, including "The Great Indian Novel" and "Inglorious Empire".
 
• He is known for his eloquent speeches and writings on Indian history and politics.
 
 
 
• **British Colonial Rule in India**
 
 
• The British colonial rule in India lasted from 1858 to 1947.
 
• During this period, India was controlled by the British Crown and administered by the British government.
 
• The colonial rule had a significant impact on India's economy, society, and culture.
 
• It also led to the Indian independence movement, which eventually resulted in India's independence in 1947.
